plugin.name: TP_Description_Editor
plugin.author: Kelaire
plugin.purpose: Miniwindow editor for short and long descriptions, keywords, area, owner, and item name

trigger.match: ^.*area is not a valid area keyword.*$

muclient.script:
local win = GetPluginID() .. '_window' local width = 530 local height = 323 -- Updated dynamically when Trivia Portal is toggled local bg, panel, border = 0x202020, 0x303030, 0x707070 local white, muted, accent = 0xFFFFFF, 0xBBBBBB, 0x44BB88 local fields = { {key='short', label='Short Description', value=''}, {key='long', label='Long Description', value=''}, {key='keywords', label='Keywords', value=''}, {key='item', label='Item Name', value=''}, {key='owner', label='Owner', value=''}, {key='area', label='Area Name', value=''}, } local trivia_portal = false local function field_value(key) for _, f in ipairs(fields) do if f.key == key then return f.value end end return '' end local visible = false local pending_area = nil local area_flags_ok = false local first_room = nil local submission = nil local pending_restring = nil
local function strip_keyword_colours(value) -- Preserve literal @@ while removing Aardwolf colour sequences. local marker = string.char(1) local plain = (value or ''):gsub('@@', marker) plain = plain:gsub('@x%d%d%d', ''):gsub('@[A-Za-z]', '') return (plain:gsub(marker, '@')) end
local function normalize_keywords(value) local words = {} for word in strip_keyword_colours(value):lower():gmatch('%S+') do if word ~= 'trivia' and word ~= 'portal' then table.insert(words, word) end end return 'trivia portal' .. (#words > 0 and (' ' .. table.concat(words, ' ')) or '') end
local function display_length(value) -- Aardwolf colour codes: @xNNN (256-colour) and @R, @w, etc. -- A doubled @@ is a literal @ and should count as one character. local placeholder = string.char(1) local plain = (value or ''):gsub('@@', placeholder) plain = plain:gsub('@x%d%d%d', ''):gsub('@[A-Za-z]', '') -- Count UTF-8 codepoints, rather than bytes, for visible characters. local _, continuation_bytes = plain:gsub('[\128-\191]', '') return #plain - continuation_bytes end
local function validate_length(f) if f.key == 'short' then local visible_count = display_length(f.value) if visible_count > 40 then ColourNote('red', '', 'TP Editor ERROR: Short Description has ' .. visible_count .. ' displayable characters (maximum 40; ' .. (visible_count - 40) .. ' over). Colour codes are ignored.') return false end return true end if f.key == 'long' and #f.value > 80 then ColourNote('yellow', '', 'TP Editor WARNING: Long Description is ' .. #f.value .. ' characters; maximum is 80 (' .. (#f.value - 80) .. ' over).') return false end return true end
local draw local clear_pending local function set_field(f, value) -- Remove leading spaces and leading @w reset codes from pasted or typed values. -- Preserve internal spaces, other colour codes, and trailing content. value = value or '' while true do local cleaned = value:gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('^@w', '') if cleaned == value then break end value = cleaned end if f.key == 'keywords' then value = strip_keyword_colours(value) end if trivia_portal and f.key == 'item' then return end f.value = value validate_length(f) draw() end local drag_offset_x, drag_offset_y = 0, 0 local x = tonumber(GetVariable('tpedit_x')) or 50 local y = tonumber(GetVariable('tpedit_y')) or 50
draw = function() -- Fit the miniwindow to the visible fields and submit button. height = trivia_portal and 415 or 323 -- Keep the current screen position when a field is edited. if WindowInfo(win, 1) ~= nil then x = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 10)) or x y = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 11)) or y end WindowCreate(win, x, y, width, height, 4, 2, bg) WindowFont(win, 'heading', 'Arial', 12, true, false, false, false) WindowFont(win, 'body', 'Consolas', 10, false, false, false, false) WindowFont(win, 'label', 'Arial', 9, true, false, false, false) WindowRectOp(win, 2, 0, 0, width, 34, 0x383838) WindowText(win, 'heading', 'Description Editor', 12, 7, width-35, 30, white) WindowAddHotspot(win, 'drag', 0, 0, width-30, 34, '', '', 'DragStart', '', '', 'Drag window', 10, 0) WindowDragHandler(win, 'drag', 'DragMove', 'DragRelease', 0) WindowText(win, 'label', 'X', width-23, 8, width-5, 28, white) WindowAddHotspot(win, 'close', width-30, 0, width, 34, '', '', '', '', 'CloseClick', 'Close window', 1, 0) local row_y = 48 for i, f in ipairs(fields) do if f.key == 'owner' or f.key == 'area' then if trivia_portal then f.y = row_y row_y = row_y + 46 else f.y = nil end else f.y = row_y row_y = row_y + 46 end if f.key == 'item' then -- The checkbox is always between Item Name and Owner / Area Name. -- Its position is drawn after all fields below. row_y = row_y + 36 end if f.y then WindowText(win, 'label', f.label, 12, f.y, width-12, f.y+20, muted) local top, bottom = f.y+17, f.y+38 WindowRectOp(win, 2, 12, top, width-12, bottom, border) WindowRectOp(win, 2, 13, top+1, width-13, bottom-1, panel) local shown = (f.key == 'keywords' and trivia_portal and normalize_keywords(f.value) or f.value):gsub('\r',''):gsub('\n',' / ') if shown == '' then shown = '(click to edit)' end if #shown > 60 then shown = shown:sub(1, 57) .. '...' end WindowText(win, 'body', shown, 19, top+3, width-18, bottom-2, f.value == '' and muted or white) WindowAddHotspot(win, 'field'..i, 12, top, width-12, bottom, '', '', '', '', 'FieldClick', 'Left-click: edit | Right-click: paste clipboard into '..f.label, 1, 0) end end local checkbox_y = 48 + 4*46 + 4 WindowRectOp(win, 2, 12, checkbox_y, 30, checkbox_y+18, border) WindowRectOp(win, 2, 14, checkbox_y+2, 28, checkbox_y+16, panel) if trivia_portal then WindowText(win, 'label', 'X', 17, checkbox_y+1, 29, checkbox_y+17, accent) end WindowText(win, 'label', 'Trivia Portal', 39, checkbox_y, 190, checkbox_y+22, white) WindowAddHotspot(win, 'trivia_toggle', 12, checkbox_y-2, 190, checkbox_y+23, '', '', '', '', 'TriviaToggle', 'Toggle Trivia Portal', 1, 0) local button_y = trivia_portal and 373 or 281 WindowRectOp(win, 2, 398, button_y, width-12, button_y+29, accent) WindowText(win, 'label', 'SUBMIT', 425, button_y+7, 505, button_y+27, 0x101010) WindowAddHotspot(win, 'submit', 398, button_y, width-12, button_y+29, '', '', '', '', 'SubmitClick', 'Submit editor values', 1, 0) WindowRectOp(win, 2, 12, button_y, 112, button_y+29, 0x707070) WindowText(win, 'label', 'CLEAR', 39, button_y+7, 105, button_y+27, white) WindowAddHotspot(win, 'clear', 12, button_y, 112, button_y+29, '', '', '', '', 'ClearClick', 'Clear all fields', 1, 0) WindowShow(win, visible) end
function TriviaToggle(flags, hotspot) if pending_restring then pending_restring = nil ColourNote('yellow', '', 'TP Editor: Pending restring cancelled by mode change.') end trivia_portal = not trivia_portal if trivia_portal then for _, f in ipairs(fields) do if f.key == 'item' then f.value = 'trivia'; break end end end draw() end
function ClearClick(flags, hotspot) pending_restring = nil pending_area = nil area_flags_ok = false first_room = nil submission = nil for _, f in ipairs(fields) do f.value = '' end -- Keep the checkbox setting; a checked portal always has a fixed item name. if trivia_portal then for _, f in ipairs(fields) do if f.key == 'item' then f.value = 'trivia'; break end end end draw() ColourNote('lightgreen', '', 'TP Editor: Fields cleared.') end
function FieldClick(flags, hotspot) local index = tonumber(hotspot:match('field(%d+)')) if not index then return end local f = fields[index] if trivia_portal and f.key == 'item' then return end -- MUSHclient hotspot flags: 0x20 = right mouse, 0x10 = left mouse. -- Right-click replaces the field with the clipboard text immediately. if bit.band(flags, 0x20) ~= 0 then local clipboard = GetClipboard() if clipboard and clipboard ~= '' then set_field(f, clipboard) else ColourNote('yellow', '', 'TP Editor: Clipboard is empty; '..f.label..' was not changed.') end return end if bit.band(flags, 0x10) ~= 0 then local response = utils.inputbox('Enter '..f.label..':', 'Description Editor', f.value) if response ~= nil then set_field(f, response) end end end
local function print_submission() ColourNote('white', 'navy', '--- Description Editor ---') for _, f in ipairs(fields) do if trivia_portal or (f.key ~= 'owner' and f.key ~= 'area') then ColourNote('lightgreen', '', f.label .. ':') end local value = (f.key == 'keywords' and trivia_portal) and normalize_keywords(f.value) or f.value if trivia_portal or (f.key ~= 'owner' and f.key ~= 'area') then ColourNote('white', '', value ~= '' and value or '(empty)') end end ColourNote('white', 'navy', '--------------------------') end
local function quote_mud(value) -- Never allow pasted line breaks to become additional MUD commands. return '"' .. (value or ''):gsub('[\r\n]+', ' '):gsub('"', '\\"') .. '"' end
local function quote_description(value, label) value = (value or ''):gsub('[\r\n]+', ' ') -- Append the reset code inside the quoted description, without duplicating it. if not value:match('@w%s*$') then value = value .. '@w' end local has_double = value:find('"', 1, true) ~= nil local has_single = value:find("'", 1, true) ~= nil if has_double and has_single then ColourNote('red', '', 'TP Editor ERROR: ' .. label .. ' contains both single and double quotes. Remove one quote type before submitting.') return nil end local delimiter = has_double and "'" or '"' return delimiter .. value .. delimiter end
clear_pending = function() pending_area = nil area_flags_ok = false first_room = nil submission = nil end
local function finish_portal() if not pending_area or not area_flags_ok or not first_room or not submission then return end local data = submission local room = first_room clear_pending()
-- The area has been checked before creating anything. ColourNote('lightgreen', '', 'TP Editor: Area validated. First room: ' .. room) Send('oload badtrip-9') Send('ostring ' .. data.item .. ' short ' .. data.short_command) Send('ostring ' .. data.item .. ' long ' .. data.long_command) Send('ostring ' .. data.item .. ' keywords ' .. quote_mud(data.keywords)) Send('ostring ' .. data.item .. ' owner ' .. quote_mud(data.owner)) Send('oset ' .. data.item .. ' destination ' .. quote_mud(room)) Send('id ' .. data.item) Send('keep ' .. data.item) ColourNote('lightgreen', '', 'TP Editor: Portal creation commands sent.') end
function SubmitClick() if pending_restring then ColourNote('yellow', '', 'TP Editor: Waiting for the item identification result. No commands sent yet.') return end if pending_area then ColourNote('yellow', '', 'TP Editor: An area validation is already in progress.') return end local valid = true for _, f in ipairs(fields) do if not validate_length(f) then valid = false end end if not valid then ColourNote('yellow', '', 'TP Editor: Please shorten the descriptions before submitting.') return end if not trivia_portal then -- Restring an existing item: only send commands for populated fields. local item = field_value('item'):match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') if item == '' or not item:match('^[%w_%-]+$') then ColourNote('red', '', 'TP Editor ERROR: Enter a valid Item Name (one keyword) to restring.') return end
local commands = {} local short = field_value('short') local long = field_value('long') local keywords = field_value('keywords') if short:match('%S') then local quoted = quote_description(short, 'Short Description') if not quoted then return end table.insert(commands, 'ostring ' .. item .. ' short ' .. quoted) end if long:match('%S') then local quoted = quote_description(long, 'Long Description') if not quoted then return end table.insert(commands, 'ostring ' .. item .. ' long ' .. quoted) end if keywords:match('%S') then table.insert(commands, 'ostring ' .. item .. ' keywords ' .. quote_mud(keywords)) end if #commands == 0 then ColourNote('yellow', '', 'TP Editor: Fill in at least one description or keywords field to restring.') return end -- Do not restring until the ID response confirms that the item is present. pending_restring = {item = item, commands = commands} ColourNote('cyan', '', 'TP Editor: Checking inventory with id ' .. item .. '...') Send('id ' .. item) return end
local item = field_value('item'):match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') if item == '' or not item:match('^[%w_%-]+$') then ColourNote('red', '', 'TP Editor ERROR: Item Name must be a single item keyword (letters, numbers, underscore, or hyphen).') return end local owner = field_value('owner'):match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') local area = field_value('area'):match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') if owner == '' or owner:find('[\r\n]') then ColourNote('red', '', 'TP Editor ERROR: Owner is required and must be one line.') return end if area == '' or area:find('[\r\n]') then ColourNote('red', '', 'TP Editor ERROR: Enter a valid, single-line area keyword.') return end
local short_command = quote_description(field_value('short'), 'Short Description') local long_command = quote_description(field_value('long'), 'Long Description') if not short_command or not long_command then return end
submission = { item = item, short_command = short_command, long_command = long_command, keywords = normalize_keywords(field_value('keywords')), owner = owner, } pending_area = area area_flags_ok = false first_room = nil ColourNote('cyan', '', 'TP Editor: Checking area ' .. area .. ' with zstat...') Send('zstat ' .. area) end
-- ID output is asynchronous. Only an explicit item-information banner authorizes -- sending the commands captured at submission time. function TPRestringFound(name, line, wildcards) if not pending_restring then return end local job = pending_restring pending_restring = nil for _, command in ipairs(job.commands) do Send(command) end ColourNote('lightgreen', '', 'TP Editor: Item found. Sent ' .. #job.commands .. ' restring command(s) for ' .. job.item .. '.') end
function TPRestringMissing(name, line, wildcards) if not pending_restring then return end local item = pending_restring.item pending_restring = nil ColourNote('red', '', 'TP Editor: You do not have ' .. item .. '. Restring cancelled; no ostring commands sent.') end
function TPAreaInvalid(name, line, wildcards) if not pending_area then return end local area = pending_area clear_pending() ColourNote('red', '', 'TP Editor ERROR: Area "' .. area .. '" is invalid (not a valid area keyword).') end
function TPAreaFlags(name, line, wildcards) if not pending_area then return end local flags = (wildcards[1] or ''):lower() local found = {} for flag in flags:gmatch('[%w_%-]+') do found[flag] = true end if found.noportals or found.epic then local area = pending_area local reasons = {} if found.noportals then table.insert(reasons, 'noportals') end if found.epic then table.insert(reasons, 'epic') end clear_pending() ColourNote('red', '', 'TP Editor ERROR: Portal cannot be created in area "' .. area .. '" (restricted area flag: ' .. table.concat(reasons, ', ') .. ').') return end area_flags_ok = true finish_portal() end
function TPFirstRoom(name, line, wildcards) if not pending_area then return end first_room = wildcards[1] finish_portal() end
function HideTPEdit() visible = false WindowShow(win, false) end function ShowTPEdit() visible = true draw() end function CloseClick(flags, hotspot) HideTPEdit() end function DragStart(flags, hotspot) -- Mouse position within the miniwindow when dragging begins. drag_offset_x = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 14)) or 0 drag_offset_y = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 15)) or 0 end function DragMove(flags, hotspot) local mouse_x = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 17)) local mouse_y = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 18)) if not mouse_x or not mouse_y then return end x = mouse_x - drag_offset_x y = mouse_y - drag_offset_y -- Reposition without recreating the miniwindow or deleting hotspots. WindowPosition(win, x, y, 4, 2) end function DragRelease(flags, hotspot) x = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 10)) or x y = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 11)) or y SetVariable('tpedit_x', tostring(x)) SetVariable('tpedit_y', tostring(y)) end function OnPluginInstall() ShowTPEdit() ColourNote('lightgreen', '', 'Description Editor loaded. Use tpedit show / tpedit hide.') end function OnPluginClose() pending_restring = nil; clear_pending(); HideTPEdit() end function OnPluginDisable() pending_restring = nil; clear_pending(); HideTPEdit() end
